summary: This lecture continues the discussion of Zadul-Ma'ad (Provisions for the Hereafter) by Ibn al-Qayyim, focusing on prophetic miracles and fulfilled prophecies. Sh. Ali Mashhour, through commentary on al-Nawawi's Tuhdhib al-Asma wa al-Lughat, explores various prophecies made by Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that came to pass, including his statement to his wives about which one would be most charitable and quickest to follow him in death (referring to Zaynab bint Jahsh), the prophecy regarding Abdullah ibn Salam, the dua for Anas ibn Malik resulting in abundant offspring and wealth, prophecies regarding Umar ibn al-Khattab accepting Islam, the supplication for Hudhayfah during the Battle of the Confederates, and the dua for Ibn Abbas to gain deep understanding of the Deen and Quranic interpretation. Each prophecy demonstrates the Prophet's knowledge of the unseen as a sign of his prophethood.
suggested_title: Prophetic Miracles and Fulfilled Prophecies: Part 144 of Zadul-Ma'ad
catchy_title: When the Prophet's Duas Changed History
